init.happening: Build the undirected graph and height slots.

loop.happening: Root a BFS or spread its frontier.
loop.why: Each node's height is measured by BFS.
loop.invariant: BFS reaches every node once per root.

update.happening: Record a distance, height, or a new minimum.
update.why: Heights and the minimum are tracked.
update.invariant: State reflects the current BFS and best.

move.happening: Dequeue, advance, or step to the next root.
move.why: BFS and the outer scan move deterministically.

check.happening: Test a new farthest, an unvisited neighbour, or a minimum.
check.why: These drive BFS and the answer.
